dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped high-contrast boundaries. The structures show a serrated perimeter geometry transitioning from low-intensity dark exterior pixels to high-intensity light interior fur, most prominent on the central and posterior lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of localized, high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients. These are primarily concentrated along the upper dorsal curve and within the larger macro-annuli structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest macro-annuli form a wide, obtuse triangle across the mid-lateral surface, with the primary axis oriented horizontally.
